## Open

### F-334 — A passing Storybook run rewrites 22 committed markup snapshots

> _2026-10-01 · tools/blong-log · open_

Running `npm run storybook:test:ci` in tools/blong-log leaves the working tree dirty: the runner
writes src/client/__markup_snapshots__/*.json on every run from .storybook/test-runner.cjs, which is
an analysis artifact and not a jest comparison, so what it writes depends on the browser it ran
with. Chromium 1243 serializes a computed style as `overflow: clip` where the committed file says
`visible`, so one run produced 22 modified files that a commit would have to explain and that no
assertion depends on. The 21 image snapshots in __image_snapshots__ are the comparison that matters;
those passed. Worth either listing the markup snapshots in .gitignore or normalising the style
properties they carry, so a local run does not hand the author a diff they did not ask for.
